_comment: One principal per API key. Stores the SHA-256 of the key, never the key. Generate with: KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32); echo "key: $KEY"; printf '%s' "$KEY" | sha256sum. 'calendars' entries are aliases from calendars.json (a raw calendar id also resolves).
